name: REDENOMINATION
description: A governed computer-work mission and exact redenomination planning rehearsal. Produces reviewable drafts and evidence; does not deploy contracts, migrate balances, execute a worker or authorize settlement.

actors.label: Alice
actors.goal: Specify the conversion, approved sources, deliverables, budget and measurable acceptance criteria.

actors.label: Hyperion-9
actors.goal: Use an approved OpenClaw or operator-led ChatGPT Work environment to prepare a candidate dossier and evidence.

actors.label: Validator Guild
actors.goal: Independently recompute base-unit arithmetic, reconcile liabilities and reject incorrect evidence before any acceptance decision.

actors.label: Sentinel Multisig
actors.goal: Review disputed evidence and follow the deployed contracts and authorized incident procedure; no powers are inferred from this demo.

actors.label: Timelock DAO
actors.goal: Separately authorize reviewed governance actions after checking the actual chain, ownership and configured timelock.

steps: Run the offline generator and verifier; inspect the source hashes and exact conversion ratio.
For a live job, commission isolated worker tools and accounts using docs/computer-work.md; the demo requires none.
Verify actual token decimals, chain, owner, identities and contracts before considering deployment or admission.
Keep signing credentials outside the worker; agree acceptance rules, dust allocation and recovery responsibilities.
Employer Alice defines a redenomination dossier using public, licensed non-personal or synthetic data.
Review computer-work/task.json, allowed origins, bounded deliverables and source data; admit its exact digest through the existing adapter.
An approved OpenClaw worker uses browser, computer, code and file tools as configured; ChatGPT Work is a separate operator-led option.
Worker returns conversion.json and dossier.md, with source references and a complete description of residual amounts.
Independent review checks every account, base-unit conversion, aggregate reconciliation and missing or duplicate entries.
Rejected or uncertain work retains its evidence and requires correction or reconciliation before a new admitted attempt.
Accepted candidate evidence enters the separately commissioned validator and contract lifecycle; provider completion does not release payment.
Production readiness requires receipts, finality, incident drills and deployment-specific authorization.
Run the guardian drill to check saved artifacts and review emergency procedures; it sends no transactions.
Rehearse an authorized pause on a disposable deployment and stop in-flight workers through their own controls.
Reconcile unknown outcomes, pending liabilities and disputed work; preserve dispatch and settlement journals.
Verify real state and required approvals before resumption. A successful offline drill is not a production-readiness certificate.
